nom: Shiseido Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 60+

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily complexions report the formula sits on top of skin and feels greasy at first, though several say it sinks in if rubbed thoroughly.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as moisturizing and non-drying, though one longtime user found the reformulated version greasy and oily where the old one was matte.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer says it does not feel greasy despite an initial impression that it might.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and no burning on the face, but one with an allergic reaction and several unrelated mentions of eye-stinging show it is not universal.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s credits long-term daily use with helping her skin look good, and another over 50 reports it caused chin breakouts.

concerns.aging: One long-term user in her 40s attributes good skin condition to daily use; no other aging-specific complaints are reported.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers with dry skin describe the product as hydrating and moisturizing on the face, with one saying it kept her face hydrated during runs.
concerns.redness: One rosacea sufferer reports zero irritation and no flare-ups even with weeks of use; this is the only rosacea-specific report.
concerns.barrier: No reviewers discuss barrier repair specifically.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says it has reduced sunspots and not worsened her hyperpigmentation; another reviewer using the old formula praised it for keeping sun spots at bay, but reported new spots/freckles appearing after use of the current version.
concerns.blemishes: One over-50 reviewer reports the product caused chin breakouts; most other reviewers do not mention breakouts either way.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers call the product very oily or greasy on the face, especially initially; a similar number of reviewers, including some with oily skin, say it is not greasy or sinks in quickly once rubbed in.

aspects.libelle: No white cast on deeper skin tones

extraits.texte: Have been using Shiseido Ultimate Sun Protection Lotion Broad Spectrum SPF 50+ WetForce mineral sunscreen (zinc oxide and titanium dioxide) for many years and they just discontinued it. Very upset about that, it was super effective, the slight white cast faded to clear within a minute, and it kept sun spots at bay. No eye stinging even if water ran into eyes. Tried this as a replacement even though it has the chemical components that I'm trying to avoid. This product goes on oily and stays very oily all day (and I have dry skin- it's definitely the product.) It made me break out on the chin and I am over 50. It's also heavily scented, so much that the scent never goes away. I can't emphasize enough how strong this perfume is, more than any facial product I've ever used. If even a smidge gets in the eyes it burns. Hate this and will be returning. I'm not even sure it's effective because after applying in the morning and spending several hours in the car driving, I came home to brown spots/freckles on the face. Don't understand the good ratings at all unless people are using it on their body but it's not good for the face!

extraits.titre: The BEST face sunscreen I've ever used!!!!
extraits.texte: Seriously! This is the absolute best face sunscreen I've ever used. I've tried so many brands and kinds- all either left a white cast, made me an oil slick, or irritated my skin. Not this beauty! This sunscreen is almost serum like, super thin and silky- with a bit of shimmer and tint that adds radiance. It I didn't have rosacea, I could probably get away with wearing only this product for the way it reflects light and adds a filter-like touch. NO irritation! So many sunscreens clog my pores or make my rosacea so mad. This caused zero issues, even after weeks of use (one of the reasons I always delay my reviews). I tend to wear a decent amount of makeup and was also worried it wouldn't sit well under it or that it would give terrible white cast in photos. Nope and nope! It almost acts like a silk primer under my medium to full coverage foundation! I do get just slightly dewy by the end of a 10 hour day, but nothing a little powder didn't fix! It's rare for me to commit to a product, but this is going to be my staple sunscreen. I will be buying numerous full bottles of this!
I love it. I have dry sensitive skin, according to my estechian, with freckles no white cast( im poc), lightweight just that price tag so i don't buy as often as i should.

I wear elta md and and I put this product before when Im out walking my dog everyday. It has really helped with less sunspots on my face and helps with not making my hyperpigmentation worse. Cant live without! Love the glow it gives as well.

I personally have sensitive skin and I find this product to work for me. The sunscreen works great for the summer time obviously but after the shower makes it feel nice and refreshing. I mainly use a ton of this for the whole body and it can cover a lot. It doesn't leave any sun burns and I feel like I can trust that I would not get so affected by the sun using this. Though I highly recommend that by any means if you're with using this around the eyes or brow. If you sweat and it goes down or if you rub your eyes with the remains of the sunscreen. It will leave a bad sting towards the eye and you would maybe get a few tears out. I know from experience so I use a little bit around the face but enough so I don't get that painful affect. If I can rate it personally, it's a 8.5/10! I do love it, it's just that one thing that makes it HORTTT! 😭

When I first received this product, I told myself, no way I am buying this again for a sunscreen (because of the size for the price). However, as soon as I put it on I fell in love. It smells great, leaves your skin super soft, and it stays soft! I have an oily complexion so I have yet to put it on my face because it does feel a bit oily when you put it on. However, I noticed if you rub it in properly it just sinks into your skin. My neck and chest in particular look and feel amazing after using this. Its not over powering, it doesnt leave a cast, a little goes a long way, and I did not have any irritaion. Yes, it is pricey, but like the other Shiseido products I have tried, I love it.

I have tattoos on my arms, and I have found this has been the best! I have had it since the begining of this year, and this sunscren has been great for me. I have combination skin, and it hasn't felt greasy on my skin, although I can understand if it may feel that way initially. It does have a slight fragrance, so if that's something that bothers you that is something to take note. Great deal as you really don't need to use too much of the product for it to work and it lasts longer for me. Highy recommend especially for vacation!
